steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The criminal justice process begins with an investigation by the police, who gather evidence and may arrest suspects under PACE 1984 | Key Fact: After arrest, the custody officer decides whether to charge the suspect, release them on bail or release them without charge | Key Fact: Bail can be granted by the police or the courts; it may be unconditional or subject to conditions such as surrendering a passport or reporting to a police station | Key Fact: Summary offences (minor crimes such as motoring offences) are tried in the Magistrates' Court without a jury
